audit.finding: Tile width/spacing, small corner Wii label, frame rules and recreated device/wrench art differ; the two destinations now work.
Generic folder/grid illustrations replace the original device/channel artwork. Heading tab lacks the breadcrumb icon; footer and tile margins differ.
Wii and GameCube use the same generic save graphic. Native platform/device silhouettes, text wrapping and title breadcrumb are missing.
The 5×3 structure exists, but grid/tab/title geometry, cell bevels, placeholder save art and bottom status differ. Native Blocks Open is replaced with a local item count.

Uses the Save Data illustration as a structural reference, not a matched Channels capture. Menu-only Disc is included as a disabled data item; Forecast falls back to text and other previews use rough static crops.

Working 240-slot paging sits in a different shell: top heading, striped blanks and a plain footer replace the native recessed page count, sculpted light footer, side arrows and help control. The small wide Nintendo source is independent but not suitable for fine font measurement.

A generic centered dialog over the grid replaces the large native title-selection panel, channel icon, side arrows and bottom To SD Card Menu/Start actions. Current Start opens the existing banner preview, rather than establishing a full native SD launch path.

Missing next-page arrow and printed version area; header/logo/footer treatment differs. In wide mode the first button is about 16 logical units wider than the high-resolution reference outline. Font is platform fallback.
Small rounded nickname button and explanatory paragraphs replace the long rectangular field. There is no footer Confirm; keyboard OK saves immediately.
A browser date input replaces the three large digit columns and up/down controls. Confirm is inline, not in the footer.
A browser time input replaces the large digit selector. Browser-local formatting and picker icon differ, and Confirm is inline.
Three small wrapping pills include a browser-specific Automatic option. Native reference has two large side-by-side preview choices, selection brackets and Confirm.
Three small horizontal pills replace a vertical stack of full-size choices. Selection uses cyan fill instead of corner brackets; no footer Confirm.
Both side page arrows are absent, while clickable page numbers serve as navigation. The shared header/footer, glow/selection and font still differ.
Previous-page arrow is absent; shared header/footer/font issues persist. Long Format text currently fits but uses different type metrics.

Top/bottom bars, buttons and remote position differ from the cropped guide illustration. Close uses a house character rather than the HOME glyph. Green battery bars indicate connection, not measured charge.
Remote graphic scale, panel margins, meter spacing, row geometry and bottom battery/close rail differ. Controls work; physical speaker/battery behavior is adapted to browser controllers.

Footer/date typography and system-card/art treatment differ. The current inventory/date/message type differs from the original envelope capture, so card position differences are not treated as a measured defect.
Recreated icons have different silhouettes, relative sizes and placement. Added text labels, background tone and Back rail differ from the cropped manual illustration.
Sheet/title/ruled-line proportions and avatar affordance differ. Back/Post are detached buttons rather than the native edge rails; font is not native.

Shop-derived keys fit, but input scroll arrows, native utility icons and layout-switch rail differ. A blank input does not show suggestions, which is expected; a separate typed-state capture proves they work.
Accent groups work, but only the normal QWERTY source is available. No native accent-page overlay or key-by-key match is claimed.
Small central numeric/T9 grid and Caps/Shift pills differ substantially from the official wide key matrix and left case/number rail.

The native wide memo source has an external trash control and edge Back rail. Current Back/Erase buttons sit inside the sheet; backdrop, text and Mii treatment differ. 4:3 is not an independent reference match.
Calendar panel is smaller and inset differently, with different arrow and Back placement, type weight and row/header proportions. Source month/day pattern differs and is cropped.
Five-row structure exists, but avatars are glyph placeholders, side page arrows are inside the book, the Wii number is always printed below, and action rails differ.
Memo art is only a related structural source for this letter view. Browser recipient select and file upload are exposed in the sheet; paper, avatar and bottom actions differ.

The blue title, Mii/photo placement, ruled text and action rails differ. Back/Reply/Erase are small internal buttons, while the native source places delete outside and Back/Reply at the lower edges. Letter content differs.

Slot A/Slot B exist, but the initial storage state is Wii, so neither slot is selected. The empty-card message and generic Wii storage shell are browser substitutes; the source is a related Wii save grid.
Item actions use a generic titled dialog with block text and Copy/Move/Erase buttons. The current source is only the parent grid, so no exact action-panel comparison is claimed.
The confirmation has generic Back/Yes/No placement. Only a parent grid source is available; Copy and cancellation work in the regression.
Channel actions reuse the generic save dialog; selected-channel icon/banner and native action-panel geometry are not reproduced. The reference is a related save grid.
Two generic Date/Time buttons are implemented. No exact reference for this intermediate menu was collected; do not infer its detailed layout from the date leaf screen.
Four destinations are wired through the generic settings list. No same-view original Screen submenu is in the source set.
Position and Sensitivity destinations work, but this intermediate page has no same-view screenshot reference.
A small cross preview and text buttons replace the framed screen-boundary preview, numeric displacement and native arrows. The offset persists immediately.
Only explanatory browser text is shown. Native 480i/480p choice and Confirm are not represented; browser output cannot change a physical Wii video mode.
Horizontal On/Off pills and an explanation replace stacked native choices and Confirm. The dimming preference itself is implemented.
Horizontal Above/Below pills replace the vertical selection panel and Confirm; text adds the phone-controller adaptation.
The sensor preview is static dots; adjustment is a browser range input. Native source has a large preview, stepped meter, minus/plus and A-to-finish instruction.
Only a PIN gate for Internet/WiiConnect24 is implemented. Native rating, secret-question and broader restriction flows are absent. The manual source shows a completed summary, not this initial setup.
A browser online-data toggle/status replaces the native Connection Settings/Console Information/User Agreements menu. Three connection slots and wireless/wired setup are absent.
A horizontal toggle and delivery explanation replace the native selector. Standby Downloads/Connection and Slot Illumination destinations are absent; no native delivery is claimed.
Small horizontal English/French/Spanish pills replace stacked localized labels and Confirm. The regression verifies persistence, not full interface translation.
Only seven countries appear as wrapping pills, without a native scroll list or Confirm. Country is also used as a compatibility inference for menu region.
Generic detail paragraphs and a small Format button replace the centered warning with bottom Cancel/Format. Behavior intentionally resets local browser data only.
An additional generic modal asks for Erase saved data. The manual source is the initial format prompt, so its second-stage geometry is unverified.

The white update-result modal has tiny viewport-scaled text and an oversized OK button. It lacks modal focus isolation and Escape navigates underlying Settings. Native reference is the update prompt, not this result state.
The custom help text makes the HOME footer overflow in both 4:3 resolutions. No original game-specific guide reference is available; content is an intentional browser guide.

The QR pairing card cuts off the close button/title in both 480-line frames. Its focus/modality also differs from native reconnect. Local and production-origin relay checks returned 404; manual pairing remains a separate untested path.
A generic form combines Wii Number/email and nickname entry. The manual Wii-number/register source is a different step; native multi-step routing and art are incomplete.
A generic text detail page replaces a native contact card; only the list illustration is available. Create Letter/Erase work locally but geometry is unverified.
Erase confirmation reuses the generic book dialog. Only a related list source is available, so exact prompt shape/placement is not claimed.
Typing hel exposes working predictions. Input/scroll controls, suggestion navigation, language/More and layout-switch artwork still differ from the original typed-state source.
